newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia inflation expectations too high-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Australia inflation expectations too high-Treasury.

text.p: Australian Treasury secretary Ted Evans said on Monday that inflation expectations were too high for the country's low-inflation environment.

"... Inflation expectations are above where we believe they ought to be if one accepts that the Reserve Bank is going to be successful in keeping inflation within the two to three percent band," Evans told a parliamentary committee.
"If the markets were accepting that, they would have interest rates lower," he said.
